title: Within-SNR frame parallelism + deterministic aggregation (gf2-sim)
description:
## Goal

Within-SNR frame parallelism with deterministic aggregation
primitives, landing inside the new `gf2-sim` crate. Per-worker
ChaCha20 stream partitioning via `set_word_pos`; order-independent
reductions; byte-identity guarantee for `fer` / `frames` /
`errors` / `mean_iters` across worker counts {1, 2, 4, 8, 24}.

## Context — scope amendment (2026-06-06, user-approved)

Originally filed (2026-06-05) as a modification to
`SimulationRunner` in `crates/gf2-coding/src/simulation.rs`.
Re-scoped during the architecture interview that created
epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`): the parallelism work moves into the
new `gf2-sim` crate as the Phase A core, providing the
deterministic-aggregation primitives every other CPU + GPU stage
builds on. Existing dep edge `e4849f07 → 3fcb7025` preserved —
the production campaign still depends on parallelism landing.

## Sequencing

- Prereq: Phase 0 design doc (`ec530af9`) — the per-worker seek
  scheme and aggregation contract are locked there.
- Prereq: gf2-sim crate scaffolding task (filed alongside this
  amendment) — provides `Pipeline`, `Stage`, batch types.

## Deliverables

1. Per-worker `ChaCha20Rng::set_word_pos` partitioning helper
   (`worker_idx`, `chunk_words` → seek offset).
2. Frame-batch dispatch primitive that runs a stage on N rayon
   workers within one SNR point, each owning its own seeked RNG.
3. Order-independent reduction of per-worker counters
   (`frames`, `errors`, `total_iterations`, `total_bits`,
   `total_bit_errors`).
4. Heartbeat / per-SNR-boundary checkpoint compatibility
   preserved (per the design doc).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Property test: parallel run on {1, 2, 4, 8, 24} workers
  produces byte-identical `fer` / `frames` / `errors` /
  `mean_iters` vs single-thread for the same seed across at least
  three (rate, modulation) configurations (DVB-T2 BICM is the
  canonical regression target).
- [hard] Throughput on AMD Ryzen 9 5900X (24 threads) ≥ **12x**
  single-thread for DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM at Es/N0=6.5 dB.
  Receipt under `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/parallelism-receipts.md`.
- [hard] Lives in `gf2-sim`; no new `unsafe`; `gf2-sim` is
  `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, and `parallelism-pays` gates
  green.
- [hard] Documentation: module-level rustdoc on the per-worker
  dispatch primitive; CLAUDE.md updated for `gf2-sim`.

## Non-goals

- GPU parallelism (handled in Phase B stages).
- Across-SNR parallelism (handled by the hybrid executor in
  Phase C).
- New channel models (Phase A.5 task).
